name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Pioneer Wyt
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a raw infrared frame for Pioneer Diamante Pro mini split heat pumps, the WYT model family, to a remote transmitter. The frame is 14 bytes; give the first 13 and the checksum is appended, or give all 14 and the last byte is replaced by the computed checksum.

config_entries.label: Code
config_entries.description: The frame to send. The checksum is computed from the first 13 bytes and stored in the 14th.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
